name: banner
description: A big title on a dark band like the mission passed screen, with an optional subtitle and metric value. Above the alert threshold of the metric the title turns into a red alert like Wasted. Also works as a plain heading.

config.name: subtitle
config.label: Subtitle
config.description: The small text below the title, followed by the value of the metric

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: An optional metric whose value follows the subtitle and that switches the title to the alert title above the threshold

config.name: alert_threshold
config.label: Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value of the metric from which the alert title is shown. 0 turns it off. Only percentages, °C and metrics with a known max value raise the alert

config.name: alert_title
config.label: Alert Title
config.description: The title shown above the threshold

config.name: hide_band
config.label: Hide Band
config.description: Hides the dark band behind the texts

config.name: font
config.label: Font
config.description: The font of the title. Defaults to Pricedown if it is installed, Impact otherwise

config.name: title_color
config.label: Title
config.description: The color of the title. Defaults to gold

config.name: text_color
config.label: Subtitle
config.description: The color of the subtitle. Defaults to white

config.name: alert_color
config.label: Alert
config.description: The color of the alert title. Defaults to red
